notes.title: Update on Eternity Warriors VR
notes.notes:
Dear Warriors!

It's been way too long and we apologise, but we think you all deserve an update on the development of Eternity Warriors VR even if it’s many months too late. 

So what happened? Why did we go silent for so long? Well, when EWVR first launched in Early Access it was actually doing fairly well. But unfortunately, EWVR was a very expensive game to maintain and the sales weren’t doing well enough for the game to sustain itself. So, we had to take on contract work, which meant our energy had to be shifted away from EWVR. This was obviously a really tough decision to make, but one we had to.

Our original intention was to always come back to EWVR once we were done with the contract work, but that sort of got away from us. We got inspired and started tinkering away at something new. Next thing you know, that little thing we were tinkering away with grew bigger and bigger and even managed to get picked up a publisher and became our next major project.

So over the next couple of months you might hear about this new project we have been working. It’s something we are really proud of, but it’s also something very different to what we’ve done with EWVR and we can’t wait to finally unveil to the world.

But what does this mean for EWVR? To be honest, we don’t know. The VR landscape has changed so much since we first started developing the game that it’s hard to say whether it would be worth it for us. Returning to EWVR has been a discussion we’ve had internally and one we continue to have. But at this moment in time we still don’t have a good definitive answer on the future of EWVR.

For the time being EWVR will remain as it is. The servers are going to remain up if you still want to play with friends and challenge high scores. Heck, if you just feel like being badass and killing some demons EWVR will always be there for you.

We understand that this might not be the news you wanted to hear and again we apologise for not giving you this update earlier. If you love EWVR we hope you continue to enjoy the game.

Thank you so much for your support. If you have any questions feel free to ask in the comments, we’ll be happy to answer!

-The Vanimals Team
